key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings associated with acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings offer a starting point for process qualification: 150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen.
method: Two-level full factorial DOE reported with 24 experimental runs.
ANOVA quantified spray-parameter contributions to coating responses.
Pareto charts assessed parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: Coating responses were measured for each run, but the abstract provides no numerical hardness, porosity, or oxide results.
watch_item: Verify the DOE structure and replication before reuse: the reported 24 runs are not explained for a four-factor, two-level full factorial design.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
